items.text: Every past discussion is in the menu at the top left, and you can continue it.
items.alt: The menu opens a list of past discussions; tapping one shows Continue this discussion

items.text: Under each contribution, mark Agree, Push back or Note; it goes with your next message.
items.alt: A tap on Push back under an adviser's contribution adds a margin note in red

items.text: Sign in on any device by typing the six-digit code from the email.
items.alt: The code from the email is typed into the sign-in field and the account is signed in
